label: Ability kinds
description: How an ability is triggered. 'Uses a key' kinds count toward the tier's key budget. Tie-break: deploy when one of the modes is stationary, otherwise toggle.

terms.label: Active
terms.description: Press to use, then a cooldown.

terms.label: Toggle / mode switch
terms.description: Switches between two modes, such as two weapons.

terms.label: Deploy
terms.description: Becomes stationary to gain a stronger mode.

terms.label: Channel
terms.description: Hold to keep it going; ends on release, interruption or when its resource runs out.

terms.label: Ultimate
terms.description: Charges up over time or through play.

terms.label: Triggered
terms.description: Happens on an event: on a kill, on death, when hit.
